items.title: Test announcement, with a picture
items.summary: This is a test of the news feed. If you can read it, news now reaches the app without an update.
points: It came from GitHub as a signed file, and the signature checked out.
The picture below was downloaded and matched its fingerprint before it was shown.
You can ignore it. It will be removed.

images.alt: A drawing of the app layout
images.caption: A test picture: sessions on the left, the chat on the right.

list: News can be published without shipping a new version.
Pictures, headings and lists all come through.
The details window opens from the summary.

items.title: Test: a CLI update notice
items.summary: This is how an update for the terminal version will show up here, so you hear about it without opening the terminal.
points: Updates for the app, the core and the CLI all land in this list.
The CLI ones can offer the exact command to copy.

sections.text: Run the command from the summary in any terminal. Your sessions and settings are shared and stay as they are.

items.title: News from mwcode, without updating
items.summary: Announcements and release notes now reach you here, even between versions.
points: The list is a signed file from GitHub. mwcode only shows it if the signature checks out.
Nothing about you is sent when it checks.
You can switch it off at the bottom of this page.

list: The feed carries a signature made with a key only the mwcode team holds. The app has the matching public key and refuses anything else.
An older copy of the feed cannot replace a newer one.
Text only: no scripts, no markup. Links open in your browser and only to github.com or the mwcode site.
Pictures are used only when their contents match a fingerprint inside the signed feed.

sections.text: At startup and about every six hours while the app is open. If you are offline, the last good copy stays.
